items.title: Seagate Stock Shakes Off AI Rally Fears With Big Earnings Beat
items.summary: Seagate Technology stock climbed after the hard-disk drive maker's quarterly results easily beat expectations.  The company touted "durable" demand from data center customers, after recent fears about the sustainability of the AI rally weighed on memory and storage stocks.  The results represent Seagate's fiscal fourth quarter.
